profile_text.body:
Box is a publicly traded company founded in 2005 and headquartered in Redwood City, California. It describes itself as offering an Intelligent Content Management platform that combines workflow automation, collaboration tools, and content security in a single system. The platform is aimed at enterprises handling unstructured data such as lease agreements, finance documents, sales presentations, and employee handbooks, allowing teams to access, share, and co-create content both inside and outside their organizations.

The company's primary AI product, Box AI, is tracked in the enterprise content category and covers metadata, governance, compliance, and retention policies. The site states that Box AI connects to AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google to deliver real-time summaries, analysis, and recommendations across large volumes of content. Additional AI-oriented features described on the site include Box AI Studio for building and customizing agents, a drag-and-drop workflow builder for automating business processes such as loan processing and employee onboarding, AI-driven security with deep learning-based malware detection, automated data classification, and built-in compliance tools for standards including GDPR, HIPAA, and FINRA. The site also notes unlimited e-signatures are available at no additional cost within the platform.

Box trades on a public exchange under the ticker BOX with CIK 0001372612. Its most recently filed 10-K, covering the period ending January 31, 2026, reported revenue of $1,177,253,000. No litigation is recorded in the held facts for this company.
